name: Metorial
tagline: Open-source integration gateway that connects AI agents to tools via MCP.
description: Metorial is an open-source integration and access layer for AI agents, exposing 1,200+ tools through the Model Context Protocol with consistent auth, permissions, and session observability. It can host custom MCP servers on serverless infrastructure and provides Python and TypeScript SDKs, a hosted cloud, and self-hosting. Every MCP session is recorded for review in its dashboard.
insight: Built by ex-Valicit founders Karim Rahme and Tobias Herber; part of Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch.
edge: Hibernating serverless MCP hosting spins servers up in under a second and idles them to zero, so you pay per request instead of per idle connection.
